title: "High-Quality" Data for Early-Stage Instruction Tuning: An Empirical Study of Data Quality Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2610.33969v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: "Data quality" is widely invoked in instruction tuning, but the term is often underspecified. We study it as an operational property by asking which simple example-level metrics, drawn from prior work on data selection, text quality, and instruction tuning, best predict training utility under a fixed finetuning budget. For each metric, we sort instruction-response examples by score, partition them into low, middle, and high bins with roughly equal token mass, finetune separately on each bin, and compare validation perplexity and LLM-as-judge scores for the models' generated answers as a function of cumulative training tokens. Our results suggest that answer-dense supervision, as captured by response ratio, is a stronger and more portable predictor of instruction-tuning utility than commonly used alternative proxies.

translated_title: 面向早期指令微调的“高质量”数据：数据质量指标的实证研究
translated_abstract: “数据质量”在指令微调中被广泛提及，但这一术语往往定义模糊。我们将其作为一种可操作的属性来研究，探讨哪些源自以往数据选择、文本质量和指令微调研究的简单样本级指标，能够在固定微调预算下最好地预测训练效用。对于每个指标，我们按分数对指令-响应对进行排序，将其划分为词元数量大致相等的低、中、高三个区间，分别在每个区间上进行微调，并将验证困惑度和基于大模型评判（LLM-as-judge）的模型生成答案得分作为累计训练词元数的函数进行对比。我们的结果表明，以响应率所刻画的答案密集型监督信号，比常用的其他替代性指标是更强、更具可迁移性的指令微调效用预测因子。
tldr: 该研究通过固定微调预算下的分箱对比实验发现，响应率所反映的答案密集程度是比其他常用替代指标更能有效预测指令微调训练效用的简单样本级数据质量指标。
en_tdlr: Through binned comparative experiments under a fixed finetuning budget, this study finds that response ratio, which captures answer-dense supervision, is a stronger and more portable sample-level predictor of instruction-tuning utility than commonly used alternative data quality metrics.
